mapper.select: SELECT point.id as pointId, point.point_name, point.iot_device_id, point.iot_device_name, point.unit, device.up_region_id, device.magnification_coefficient, point.channel_num, device.iot_device_type, device.ip, device.port, device.address, device.meter_type, device.up_region_name FROM t_iot_device device LEFT JOIN t_iot_device_point point ON device.id = point.iot_device_id where device.ip = #{ip}

SELECT point.iot_device_id, point.iot_device_name, point.id AS point_id, point.channel_num, point.point_name, device.iot_device_type, device.controllable, device.magnification_coefficient, device.address, device.up_region_id, point.unit, robot.robot_code, b.up_dict AS type FROM t_iot_device device LEFT JOIN t_iot_device_point point ON device.id = point.iot_device_id LEFT JOIN t_robot_info robot ON robot.robot_ip = device.ip AND device.protocol_model = 7 LEFT JOIN t_dict_business b ON device.iot_device_type = b.dict_code AND b.col_name = 'iot_device_type' WHERE 1 = 1
and device.iot_device_type != 840
and device.iot_device_type = 840
and device.up_region_id in
#{regionId}
GROUP BY point.id

SELECT b.id, b.point_id, b.point_name, b.iot_device_id, b.iot_device_name, ROUND(b.`value` - a.`value`, 2) * b.magnification_coefficient AS `value`, b.unit, b.up_region_id, b.create_time, b.magnification_coefficient FROM ( SELECT *, DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS lastTime FROM t_iot_device_data where iot_device_id = #{iotDeviceId} and create_time between #{startTime} and #{endTime} GROUP BY lastTime ORDER BY create_time ) b LEFT JOIN ( SELECT *, DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS lastTime FROM t_iot_device_data where iot_device_id = #{iotDeviceId} and create_time between #{startTime} and #{endTime} GROUP BY lastTime ORDER BY create_time ) a ON b.lastTime = DATE_ADD(a.lastTime, INTERVAL 1 DAY) WHERE a.`value` is not null

SELECT ROUND(SUM(a.`value` * a.magnification_coefficient), 2) AS allTotal, b.region_name AS regionName FROM ( SELECT (CASE WHEN a.`value` - b.`value` <= 0 or a.`value` - b.`value` > 10 THEN 0 ELSE a.`value` - b.`value` END) AS `value`, a.edge_code, a.magnification_coefficient FROM ( SELECT a.point_id, a.`value`, a.magnification_coefficient, a.create_time, a.edge_code, DATE_FORMAT(a.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS lastTime FROM t_iot_device_data a LEFT JOIN t_iot_device_point b ON a.point_id = b.id LEFT JOIN t_iot_device c ON b.iot_device_id = c.id WHERE a.id in (SELECT id FROM t_iot_device_data WHERE iot_device_type = 840 AND point_name LIKE '%正向有功总%') AND c.meter_type = 1 GROUP BY a.point_id, lastTime ORDER BY lastTime DESC ) a LEFT JOIN ( SELECT a.point_id, a.`value`, a.magnification_coefficient, a.create_time, a.edge_code, DATE_FORMAT(a.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS lastTime FROM t_iot_device_data a LEFT JOIN t_iot_device_point b ON a.point_id = b.id LEFT JOIN t_iot_device c ON b.iot_device_id = c.id WHERE a.id in (SELECT id FROM t_iot_device_data WHERE iot_device_type = 840 AND point_name LIKE '%正向有功总%') AND c.meter_type = 1 GROUP BY a.point_id, lastTime ORDER BY lastTime DESC ) b ON a.point_id = b.point_id AND a.lastTime = DATE_ADD(b.lastTime, INTERVAL 1 DAY) WHERE a.create_time between #{startTime} and #{endTime} ) a LEFT JOIN t_std_region b ON a.edge_code = b.region_code WHERE b.state = 1 GROUP BY a.edge_code
